description.sk: Hrubá zemiakovo-vaječná omeleta, výborná teplá aj studená.
description.en: A thick potato and egg omelette, great warm or cold.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na tenké plátky, cibuľu na tenké pásiky.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes and slice them thinly; slice the onion into thin strips.

steps.sk: Zemiaky s cibuľou a polovicou soli nechaj na olivovom oleji na miernom ohni prikryté 20 minút dusiť, kým nie sú mäkké, ale nie opečené. Občas premiešaj.
steps.en: Cook the potatoes and onion with half the salt in the olive oil over low heat, covered, for 20 minutes until soft but not browned. Stir occasionally.

steps.sk: Vajcia rozšľahaj so zvyšnou soľou, vmiešaj zemiaky a nechaj 5 minút odstáť. Na panvici nechaj asi lyžicu oleja.
steps.en: Beat the eggs with the remaining salt, stir in the potatoes and let it stand for 5 minutes. Leave about a tablespoon of oil in the pan.

steps.sk: Zmes vlej späť na panvicu a peč na miernom ohni 6 minút, kým okraje nestuhnú.
steps.en: Pour the mixture back into the pan and cook over low heat for 6 minutes until the edges are set.

steps.sk: Tortillu prevráť pomocou taniera a dopeč druhú stranu 3 až 4 minúty, kým stred nie je pevný. Pred krájaním nechaj chvíľu odpočinúť.
steps.en: Flip the tortilla using a plate and cook the other side for 3–4 minutes until the centre is firm. Let it rest briefly before cutting.

title.sk: Francúzska omeleta s hubami a syrom
title.en: French omelette with mushrooms and cheese

description.sk: Hodvábna omeleta za desať minút – rýchle raňajky plné bielkovín.
description.en: A silky omelette in ten minutes: a quick protein-packed breakfast.

steps.sk: Huby nakrájaj na plátky a na polovici masla ich opeč dozlatista, asi 4 minúty. Odlož ich.
steps.en: Slice the mushrooms and fry them in half the butter until golden, about 4 minutes. Set aside.

steps.sk: Vajcia rozšľahaj so soľou a korením.
steps.en: Beat the eggs with salt and pepper.

steps.sk: Na strednom ohni rozpusti zvyšné maslo, vlej vajcia a stierkou ich neustále pomaly posúvaj, kým nie sú takmer stuhnuté, ale na povrchu ešte krémové, asi 2 minúty.
steps.en: Melt the remaining butter over medium heat, pour in the eggs and keep slowly pushing them with a spatula until almost set but still creamy on top, about 2 minutes.

steps.sk: Na jednu polovicu daj huby a strúhaný syr, omeletu preklop a nechaj ju zošmyknúť na tanier. Posyp pažítkou.
steps.en: Put the mushrooms and grated cheese on one half, fold the omelette over and slide it onto a plate. Sprinkle with chives.

description.sk: Teplé jablká pod chrumkavou maslovou posýpkou.
description.en: Warm apples under a crunchy buttery topping.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 190 °C.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 190 °C.

steps.sk: Jablká ošúp, zbav jadrovníkov, nakrájaj na kúsky a v zapekacej mise ich premiešaj s citrónovou šťavou, polovicou škorice a lyžicou cukru.
steps.en: Peel and core the apples, cut into chunks and toss them in a baking dish with the lemon juice, half the cinnamon and a tablespoon of the sugar.

steps.sk: Múku, vločky, zvyšný cukor a škoricu zmiešaj so studeným maslom nakrájaným na kocky a prstami rozdrv na hrudkovitú posýpku.
steps.en: Mix the flour, oats, remaining sugar and cinnamon with the cold diced butter and rub with your fingertips into a lumpy crumble.

steps.sk: Posýpku rozsyp na jablká a peč 35 minút, kým nie je zlatistá a jablká na okrajoch nebublajú.
steps.en: Scatter the crumble over the apples and bake for 35 minutes until golden and the apples bubble at the edges.

steps.sk: Nechaj 5 minút vychladnúť a podávaj teplé, napríklad s bielym jogurtom.
steps.en: Let it cool for 5 minutes and serve warm, for example with plain yogurt.

description.sk: Hustý paprikový guláš so zemiakmi – ešte lepší na druhý deň.
description.en: A thick paprika goulash with potatoes, even better the next day.

steps.sk: Na masti pomaly opekaj nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu do zlatohneda, asi 12 minút – je základom chuti.
steps.en: Slowly fry the finely chopped onions in the lard until golden brown, about 12 minutes; they carry the flavour.

steps.sk: Pridaj mäso nakrájané na 3 cm kocky a opeč ho zo všetkých strán.
steps.en: Add the beef cut into 3 cm cubes and brown it on all sides.

steps.sk: Stiahni z ohňa, vmiešaj papriku, rascu a pretlak, zalej 1 l vody, osoľ a nechaj prikryté dusiť 60 minút.
steps.en: Take off the heat, stir in the paprika, caraway and tomato paste, add 1 l water and the salt and simmer covered for 60 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj zemiaky a papriku nakrájané na kocky a var ďalších 25 minút, kým mäso nie je mäkké a dá sa ľahko rozdeliť vidličkou.
steps.en: Add the diced potatoes and pepper and simmer for another 25 minutes, until the beef is tender and comes apart easily with a fork.

steps.sk: Dochuť prelisovaným cesnakom, majoránom a korením.
steps.en: Finish with crushed garlic, marjoram and pepper.

title.sk: Paella s kuracím mäsom a krevetami

description.sk: Šafránovo žltá ryža z jednej panvice, s údenou paprikou.
description.en: Golden one-pan rice with smoked paprika.

steps.sk: Bujóny rozpusti v 900 ml horúcej vody.
steps.en: Dissolve the stock cubes in 900 ml hot water.

steps.sk: Na olivovom oleji vo veľkej panvici opeč kuracie kúsky dozlatista, asi 6 minút. Pridaj cibuľu, papriku a cesnak a opekaj 4 minúty.
steps.en: Brown the chicken pieces in the olive oil in a large pan, about 6 minutes. Add the onion, pepper and garlic and fry for 4 minutes.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj údenú papriku, kurkumu, paradajky a ryžu a minútu opekaj.
steps.en: Stir in the smoked paprika, turmeric, tomatoes and rice and fry for a minute.

steps.sk: Zalej vývarom, rovnomerne rozlož a už nemiešaj. Var na miernom ohni 15 minút.
steps.en: Pour in the stock, spread everything evenly and stop stirring. Simmer for 15 minutes.

steps.sk: Navrch poukladaj krevety a hrášok a var ešte 5 až 7 minút, kým krevety nie sú ružové a nepriehľadné a ryža vsiakne tekutinu.
steps.en: Arrange the shrimp and peas on top and cook for 5–7 more minutes, until the shrimp are pink and opaque and the rice has absorbed the liquid.

steps.sk: Nechaj 5 minút odpočinúť pod utierkou a podávaj s citrónom.
steps.en: Rest for 5 minutes under a tea towel and serve with lemon.

description.sk: Studená španielska zeleninová polievka na horúce dni.
description.en: A chilled Spanish vegetable soup for hot days.

steps.sk: Zeleninu nahrubo nakrájaj a chlieb namoč na minútu do vody.
steps.en: Roughly chop the vegetables and soak the bread in water for a minute.

steps.sk: Všetko rozmixuj s olejom, octom a soľou dohladka.
steps.en: Blend everything with the oil, vinegar and salt until smooth.

steps.sk: Dochuť a daj aspoň na hodinu vychladiť. Podávaj s pár kockami uhorky.
steps.en: Adjust the seasoning and chill for at least an hour. Serve with a few cubes of cucumber.

description.sk: Provensálska dusená zelenina s tymianom, výborná aj studená.
description.en: Provençal stewed vegetables with thyme, also lovely cold.

steps.sk: Baklažán, cukety a papriky nakrájaj na 2 cm kocky.
steps.en: Cut the eggplant, zucchini and peppers into 2 cm cubes.

steps.sk: Na polovici oleja opeč baklažán dozlatista, asi 6 minút, a odlož ho. Na zvyšnom oleji opeč cukety a papriky 5 minút.
steps.en: Fry the eggplant in half the oil until golden, about 6 minutes, and set aside. Fry the zucchini and peppers in the rest of the oil for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj cibuľu a cesnak, potom paradajky, tymian, baklažán, soľ a korenie.
steps.en: Add the onion and garlic, then the tomatoes, thyme, eggplant, salt and pepper.

steps.sk: Nechaj prikryté dusiť na miernom ohni 30 minút, kým zelenina nezmäkne. Posyp bazalkou.
steps.en: Simmer covered over low heat for 30 minutes until the vegetables are soft. Sprinkle with basil.

title.sk: Pečená treska v strúhanke s hranolkami

description.sk: Chrumkavá ryba aj hranolky z rúry, bez fritézy.
description.en: Crispy fish and chips from the oven, no deep fryer.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 220 °C. Zemiaky nakrájaj na hrubé hranolky, premiešaj s 2 lyžicami oleja a polovicou soli a rozlož na plech.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Cut the potatoes into thick chips, toss with 2 tablespoons of oil and half the salt and spread on a tray.

steps.sk: Peč 20 minút.
steps.en: Bake for 20 minutes.

steps.sk: Rybu osuš, osoľ a okoreň. Obaľ ju v múke, rozšľahanom vajci a strúhanke zmiešanej so zvyšným olejom.
steps.en: Pat the fish dry and season. Coat it in flour, beaten egg and the breadcrumbs mixed with the remaining oil.

steps.sk: Hranolky otoč, rybu polož na plech vedľa nich a peč 12 až 15 minút, kým obal nie je zlatistý a ryba sa ľahko rozdeľuje na lupienky.
steps.en: Turn the chips, put the fish on the tray next to them and bake for 12–15 minutes until the coating is golden and the fish flakes easily.

steps.sk: Podávaj s citrónom a hráškom.
steps.en: Serve with lemon and peas.

description.sk: Nadýchaná trhaná palacinka s hrozienkami a lekvárom.
description.en: A fluffy torn pancake with raisins and plum jam.

steps.sk: Žĺtky vyšľahaj s mliekom, múkou a soľou. Bielky s cukrom vyšľahaj na tuhý sneh a zľahka vmiešaj.
steps.en: Whisk the yolks with the milk, flour and salt. Beat the whites with the sugar to stiff peaks and fold in gently.

steps.sk: Na veľkej panvici rozpusti polovicu masla, vlej cesto, posyp hrozienkami a peč na miernom ohni 5 minút, kým spodok nezhnedne.
steps.en: Melt half the butter in a large pan, pour in the batter, scatter the raisins and cook over low heat for 5 minutes until the base is golden.

steps.sk: Rozdeľ na štvrtiny, otoč, pridaj zvyšné maslo a dopeč 3 minúty. Potom dvoma vidličkami roztrhaj na kúsky a krátko opeč.
steps.en: Cut into quarters, flip, add the remaining butter and cook for 3 minutes. Then tear into pieces with two forks and toss briefly.

steps.sk: Posyp práškovým cukrom a podávaj s lekvárom.
steps.en: Dust with powdered sugar and serve with the plum jam.

title.sk: Nemecký zemiakový šalát s octom a cibuľou
title.en: German potato salad with vinegar and onion

description.sk: Ľahký šalát bez majonézy, zaliaty teplým vývarom s octom.
description.en: A light salad without mayonnaise, dressed with warm broth and vinegar.

steps.sk: Zemiaky uvar v šupke doměkka, asi 25 minút, ošúp a ešte teplé nakrájaj na tenké plátky.
steps.en: Boil the potatoes in their skins until tender, about 25 minutes, peel and slice thinly while still warm.

steps.sk: Bujón rozpusti v 200 ml horúcej vody, pridaj nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu, ocot, horčicu a cukor a priveď do varu.
steps.en: Dissolve the stock cube in 200 ml hot water, add the finely chopped onion, vinegar, mustard and sugar and bring to the boil.

steps.sk: Zalej zemiaky horúcim nálevom, premiešaj a nechaj 15 minút nasiaknuť.
steps.en: Pour the hot dressing over the potatoes, toss and leave to soak for 15 minutes.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj olej, korenie a pažítku. Podávaj vlažný alebo studený.
steps.en: Stir in the oil, pepper and chives. Serve lukewarm or cold.

description.sk: Krehký koláč s vaječno-smotanovou plnkou a slaninou.
description.en: A crisp pastry case with a creamy egg and bacon filling.

steps.sk: Múku so štipkou soli rozdrob so studeným maslom, pridaj 1 vajce a 2 lyžice studenej vody a rýchlo vypracuj cesto. Daj ho na 20 minút do chladničky.
steps.en: Rub the flour and a pinch of salt with the cold butter, add 1 egg and 2 tablespoons of cold water and quickly bring together into a dough. Chill for 20 minutes.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 190 °C. Cesto rozvaľkaj, vylož ním formu, prepichaj vidličkou a peč 12 minút.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Roll out the pastry, line a tart tin, prick with a fork and bake for 12 minutes.

steps.sk: Slaninu opeč nasucho do chrumkava. Zvyšné vajcia vyšľahaj so smotanou, mliekom, muškátovým orieškom, soľou a korením.
steps.en: Fry the bacon until crisp. Whisk the remaining eggs with the cream, milk, nutmeg, salt and pepper.

steps.sk: Na predpečený korpus rozsyp slaninu a syr, zalej vajíčkovou zmesou a peč 30 minút, kým plnka v strede nestuhne.
steps.en: Scatter the bacon and cheese over the pastry case, pour in the egg mixture and bake for 30 minutes until the filling is just set in the centre.

steps.sk: Nechaj 10 minút vychladnúť a krájaj.
steps.en: Cool for 10 minutes before cutting.

description.sk: Francúzsky poulet à la moutarde: krémová omáčka s dijonskou horčicou.
description.en: French poulet à la moutarde: a creamy Dijon mustard sauce.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp a var v osolenej vode 20 minút doměkka.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes and boil in salted water for 20 minutes until tender.

steps.sk: Stehná osoľ, okoreň a na masle opeč kožou nadol 6 minút, otoč a opeč ešte 4 minúty. Odlož ich.
steps.en: Season the thighs and brown them in the butter skin side down for 6 minutes, then turn and cook for 4 more minutes. Set aside.

steps.sk: Na výpeku speň cibuľu s cesnakom, podlej vínom a nechaj ho zredukovať na polovicu.
steps.en: Soften the onion and garlic in the pan juices, add the wine and reduce by half.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj smotanu, horčicu a tymian, vráť mäso a var prikryté 12 minút, kým nie je vnútri prepečené (75 °C).
steps.en: Stir in the cream, mustard and thyme, return the chicken and simmer covered for 12 minutes until cooked through (75 °C).

steps.sk: Podávaj so zemiakmi a omáčkou.
steps.en: Serve with the potatoes and sauce.

title.sk: Francúzska cibuľová polievka so syrovou hrenkou
title.en: French onion soup with cheese toast

description.sk: Sladká karamelizovaná cibuľa, vývar a gratinovaný chlieb.
description.en: Sweet caramelised onions, broth and a gratinated cheese toast.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké polkolieska a na masle ju na miernom ohni 40 minút pomaly karamelizuj do tmavozlata. Občas premiešaj.
steps.en: Slice the onions thinly and cook them slowly in the butter over low heat for 40 minutes until deep golden. Stir now and then.

steps.sk: Posyp múkou, minútu opekaj, podlej vínom a zalej 1,2 l vody s bujónmi. Pridaj tymian a bobkový list a var 20 minút.
steps.en: Dust with the flour, cook for a minute, add the wine and 1.2 l water with the stock cubes. Add the thyme and bay leaf and simmer for 20 minutes.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 220 °C (gril). Chlieb opeč, polož na polievku v miskách vhodných do rúry a posyp syrom.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 220 °C (grill). Toast the bread, float it on the soup in ovenproof bowls and top with the cheese.

steps.sk: Zapekaj 5 minút, kým syr nebublá.
steps.en: Grill for 5 minutes until the cheese bubbles.

description.sk: Sýty šalát s tuniakom, vajíčkom, zemiakmi a fazuľkou.
description.en: A filling salad with tuna, egg, potatoes and green beans.

steps.sk: Zemiaky var 15 minút doměkka, posledné 4 minúty k nim pridaj fazuľku. Vajcia var 8 minút.
steps.en: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes until tender, adding the green beans for the last 4 minutes. Boil the eggs for 8 minutes.

steps.sk: Dresing: olej vyšľahaj s octom, horčicou a soľou.
steps.en: Dressing: whisk the oil with the vinegar, mustard and salt.

steps.sk: Na tanier rozlož šalát, nakrájané zemiaky, fazuľku, paradajky, cibuľu a olivy, navrch tuniaka a rozpolené vajíčka.
steps.en: Arrange the lettuce, sliced potatoes, beans, tomatoes, onion and olives on plates and top with the tuna and halved eggs.

steps.sk: Polej dresingom a podávaj.
steps.en: Drizzle with the dressing and serve.

description.sk: Chrumkavé pečené zemiaky s paradajkovou omáčkou a cesnakovým dipom.
description.en: Crispy roast potatoes with a spicy tomato sauce and garlic dip.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 220 °C. Zemiaky nakrájaj na kocky, premiešaj s 2 lyžicami oleja, polovicou soli a údenej papriky.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Dice the potatoes and toss with 2 tablespoons of oil, half the salt and half the smoked paprika.

steps.sk: Peč 35 až 40 minút do chrumkava, v polovici premiešaj.
steps.en: Roast for 35–40 minutes until crisp, stirring halfway.

steps.sk: Omáčka: na zvyšnom oleji opeč 1 strúčik cesnaku, zvyšnú papriku a čili, pridaj paradajky a soľ a var 10 minút.
steps.en: Sauce: fry 1 garlic clove with the remaining paprika and the chili in the rest of the oil, add the tomatoes and salt and simmer for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Majonézu zmiešaj s druhým prelisovaným strúčikom cesnaku. Zemiaky polej omáčkou a podávaj s dipom.
steps.en: Mix the mayonnaise with the second crushed garlic clove. Top the potatoes with the sauce and serve with the dip.

title.sk: Cícer so špenátom na španielsky spôsob

description.sk: Garbanzos con espinacas: rastlinné tapas s údenou paprikou a opečeným chlebom.
description.en: Garbanzos con espinacas: plant-based tapas with smoked paprika and fried bread.

steps.sk: Na polovici oleja opeč chlieb nakrájaný na kocky s cesnakom dozlatista. Rozmixuj alebo roztlač s octom a paprikou na hrubú pastu.
steps.en: Fry the cubed bread with the garlic in half the oil until golden. Blend or mash with the vinegar and paprika into a coarse paste.

steps.sk: Na zvyšnom oleji nechaj zavädnúť špenát s rímskym kmínom.
steps.en: Wilt the spinach with the cumin in the remaining oil.

steps.sk: Pridaj cícer, chlebovú pastu, soľ a 150 ml vody a var 8 minút, kým omáčka nezhustne.
steps.en: Add the chickpeas, bread paste, salt and 150 ml water and simmer for 8 minutes until thick.

title.sk: Kura s chorizom a fazuľou z jedného hrnca
title.en: One-pot chicken with chorizo and beans

description.sk: Dymové kura s fazuľou a paradajkami – málo riadu, veľa chuti.
description.en: Smoky chicken with beans and tomatoes: few dishes, lots of flavour.

steps.sk: Na oleji opeč chorizo nakrájané na kolieska, kým nepustí červený tuk. Pridaj mäso a opeč ho zo všetkých strán.
steps.en: Fry the sliced chorizo in the oil until it releases its red fat. Add the chicken and brown it on all sides.

steps.sk: Pridaj cibuľu, papriku, cesnak a údenú papriku a opekaj 3 minúty.
steps.en: Add the onion, pepper, garlic and smoked paprika and fry for 3 minutes.

steps.sk: Prilej paradajky a 150 ml vody, osoľ a nechaj prikryté dusiť 20 minút.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes and 150 ml water, season with salt and simmer covered for 20 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj fazuľu a var ešte 5 minút, kým kura nie je vnútri prepečené (75 °C). Posyp petržlenovou vňaťou.
steps.en: Add the beans and simmer for 5 more minutes until the chicken is cooked through (75 °C). Sprinkle with parsley.

title.sk: Cottage pie – mäso pod zemiakovou kašou

description.sk: Britská zapekaná klasika: hovädzie so zeleninou pod chrumkavou kašou.
description.en: A British bake: beef and vegetables under a crispy mash.

steps.sk: Zemiaky ošúp a var v osolenej vode 20 minút doměkka. Roztlač ich s maslom, mliekom a polovicou soli na kašu.
steps.en: Peel the potatoes and boil in salted water for 20 minutes until tender. Mash with the butter, milk and half the salt.

steps.sk: Na oleji speň cibuľu a mrkvu nakrájanú na kocky, pridaj mäso a opekaj, kým nie je bez ružovej farby.
steps.en: Soften the diced onion and carrots in the oil, add the beef and brown until no pink remains.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj múku a pretlak, prilej 300 ml vody s bujónom, pridaj tymian a zvyšnú soľ a var 15 minút. Vmiešaj hrášok.
steps.en: Stir in the flour and tomato paste, add 300 ml water with the stock cube, the thyme and remaining salt and simmer for 15 minutes. Stir in the peas.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Mäso daj do misy, navrch rozotri kašu, vidličkou urob ryhy a posyp syrom.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Put the meat in a dish, spread the mash on top, rough it up with a fork and sprinkle with the cheese.

steps.sk: Peč 25 minút, kým povrch nie je zlatohnedý a okraje nebublajú.
steps.en: Bake for 25 minutes until golden brown and bubbling at the edges.

title.sk: Fazuľa v paradajkovej omáčke na toaste

description.sk: Britské študentské raňajky aj večera – domáca a lacná.
description.en: A British student breakfast or supper, homemade and cheap.

steps.sk: Na oleji speň nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu, pridaj passatu, papriku, cukor, ocot a soľ a var 5 minút.
steps.en: Soften the finely chopped onion in the oil, add the passata, paprika, sugar, vinegar and salt and simmer for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj fazuľu a povar ešte 3 minúty.
steps.en: Add the beans and simmer for 3 more minutes.

steps.sk: Chlieb opeč, polož naň fazuľu a podľa chuti posyp strúhaným čedarom.
steps.en: Toast the bread, spoon the beans on top and sprinkle with grated cheddar if you like.
